retrievalProfile.description: Use this skill for high-contrast, direct-flash photography featuring theatrical poses against neutral, textured backdrops with a distinct 90s analog film grain.
triggerTerms: direct flash portrait with harsh shadows
excludeWhen: modern digital clean look is preferred
outdoor landscapes are the primary focus

recipe.visualDefinition: A high-contrast fashion portrait characterized by harsh direct flash, heavy film grain, and a theatrical, narrative-driven pose. The subject is a blonde woman in a black mini-dress, positioned on all fours, interacting with a secondary figure (only legs visible), set against a backdrop of vertical white pleated curtains that create rhythmic vertical lines.
coreVisualRelationships: Subject's blonde hair contrasting against the dark black dress
Harsh direct flash creating deep, sharp shadows on the background curtains
Vertical curtain pleats providing a structured grid for the organic human form
The interaction between the subject's hand and the standing figure's leg creating a diagonal tension
coreInvariants: Heavy analog film grain across all tonal ranges
Blown-out highlights on skin and light fabrics due to direct flash
Deep, crushed blacks in clothing and shadows
Warm, slightly reddish skin tones typical of vintage film stock

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: The primary subject is centered horizontally, occupying the lower two-thirds of the frame in a dynamic, low-profile pose.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The subject's face, framed by voluminous blonde hair, serves as the primary focal point.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: The eye follows the vertical line of the standing leg down to the subject's hand, then moves across her body to her face, and finally down her back to the heels.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: The upper third of the image is dominated by the neutral, vertical texture of the curtains, providing breathing room for the busy lower composition.

colorSystem.accentColorRole: Golden blonde (hair) and warm peach (skin tones)
colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: High value contrast with moderate saturation; colors are grounded in warm, earthy film-like undertones.
paletteRestrictions: Limited to monochromatic neutrals with warm skin accents

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: Generate a high-contrast photograph of a blonde woman in a black dress on a beige carpet against white curtains, using harsh direct flash and 35mm film grain.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: If adding text, use a thin, spaced-out serif font in white or gold, placed in the upper third of the frame to avoid overlapping the subject.

verificationChecks: Is the shadow behind the subject sharp and dark?
Is there visible film grain throughout the image?
Are the highlights on the skin slightly overexposed?
Is the color palette restricted to black, white, and warm skin tones?

mustRedesign: Avoid digital sharpness or lack of noise

mustAchieve: Tactile texture in the curtains and carpet

postGenerationChecks: Check for harsh drop shadows on the curtains
Ensure the blonde hair has high-key highlights
Verify the presence of heavy analog-style grain
Confirm the composition feels like a candid editorial snapshot
Check that the black dress retains some texture despite deep shadows
recipe.reuseFormula: Combine [Direct Flash] + [35mm Film Grain] + [Neutral Textured Backdrop] + [High Contrast Fashion Pose] to replicate this vintage editorial style.
